OpenAI introduce una versione dedicata agli utenti tra i 13 e i 17 anni. Il sistema include il riconoscimento automatico dell'età, filtri per le risposte e maggiori controlli parentali.

item.description:

item.title: Unitree shares surge 600% on Chinese stock market debut
item.description:
Humanoid robot maker Unitree saw shares jump over 600% following its debut on the Chinese stock market. The company has gained international recognition for robots capable of performing martial arts and dancing.
